props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the viewport. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: controllerRef
props.description: Receives the imperative controller once, during setup.

props.name: edgeThreshold
props.description: Distance in pixels from an edge within which it counts as reached.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Renders one collection item. Takes the place of `children`.

props.name: onOverflowChange
props.description: Called when the overflowing edges change.

props.name: onReachEnd
props.description: Called when scrolling reaches the end edge of an overflowing axis.

props.name: onReachStart
props.description: Called when scrolling reaches the start edge of an overflowing axis.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description:
Scrollbar presentation. `auto` shows custom scrollbars while an axis overflows, `always` keeps
them visible, `hover` shows them while the pointer is over the area or it scrolls, `scroll`
shows them while it scrolls, `native` keeps browser scrollbars, and `hidden` hides every
scrollbar while retaining scrolling.

props.name: scrollHideDelay
props.description: Milliseconds `hover` and `scroll` scrollbars stay visible after activity ends.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Whether edges with more content beyond them fade out as a shadow.

props.name: shadowSize
props.description: Shadow length in pixels while `shadow` is enabled.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the visible `items`. The viewport is the scroll container; create the
virtualizer with `horizontal` for `orientation="horizontal"`.
